issue.title: undefined reference with debian11_armv7 on docker Ubutun18.04 linux/arm/v7
issue.body:
The version 1.0.8 of MAVSDK fixed the undefined reference of the debian install for the RPi, but not for a docker container with Ubuntu 18.04 and with a target platform of linux/arm/v7. I am so close to successfully launching my MAVSDK application from a docker container :)

With v1.0.8, I have the following errors with the package _debian11_armv6_ and _debian11_armv7_ 
```
#9 46.48 -- Configuring done
#9 46.51 -- Generating done
#9 46.52 -- Build files have been written to: /MAVSDK/examples/takeoff_and_land/build
#9 47.16 Scanning dependencies of target takeoff_and_land
#9 47.33 [ 50%] Building CXX object CMakeFiles/takeoff_and_land.dir/takeoff_and_land.cpp.o
#9 55.07 [100%] Linking CXX executable takeoff_and_land
#9 55.64 /usr/lib/libmavsdk.so.1.0.8: undefined reference to `fcntl64@GLIBC_2.28'
#9 55.64 /usr/lib/libmavsdk.so.1.0.8: undefined reference to `fcntl@GLIBC_2.28'
#9 55.65 collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
#9 55.67 CMakeFiles/takeoff_and_land.dir/build.make:95: recipe for target 'takeoff_and_land' failed

#9 55.67 Makefile:83: recipe for target 'all' failed
#9 55.67 make: *** [all] Error 2
```

`Dockerfile` to reproduce + need to build for linux/arm/v7:
```
FROM ubuntu:18.04

ARG TARGETPLATFORM

# Install dependencies
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get -y --quiet --no-install-recommends install \
        build-essential \
        ca-certificates \ 
        git \ 
        sudo \ 
        wget \
        cmake \
    && apt-get -y autoremove \
    && apt-get clean autoclean \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/{apt,dpkg,cache,log} /tmp/* /var/tmp/*

# Install MAVSDK prebuilt C++ library
ENV MAVSDK_VERSION=1.0.7
RUN if [ "$TARGETPLATFORM" = "linux/amd64" ]; then MAVSDK_PKG=ubuntu18.04_amd64; \
    elif [ "$TARGETPLATFORM" = "linux/arm/v7" ]; then MAVSDK_PKG=debian11_armv7; \
    else MAVSDK_PKG=ubuntu18.04_amd64; fi \
    && wget https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/releases/download/v${MAVSDK_VERSION}/libmavsdk-dev_${MAVSDK_VERSION}_${MAVSDK_PKG}.deb \
    && sudo dpkg -i libmavsdk-dev_${MAVSDK_VERSION}_${MAVSDK_PKG}.deb \
    && sudo rm libmavsdk-dev_${MAVSDK_VERSION}_${MAVSDK_PKG}.deb

# Run MAVSDK takeoff example
RUN git clone https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK.git --recursive \
    && cd MAVSDK/examples/takeoff_and_land/ \
    && cmake -Bbuild -H. \
    && cmake --build build
```
potential linked issue: #1673
